messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: AMORE package with Rejin plugin for eclipse
parts:
It looks like this package uses C/C++/Fortran code, and Renjin is not (yet) able to translate this code to jvm byte code.

We will have a new release out in the next week, check back then!
